[EN] You found someone's journal. Apparently, this was Hennika's diary, when she was still a child.
[ES] Encontraste el diario de alguien. Aparentemente, este era el diario de Hennika cuando aún era una niña.

[EN] Detrian is gone. He made a wooden doll for me, and I still keep it in my bed.
I feel strange. Detrian’s stuff is here, but he is gone.
His clothes are still here. His sword is here. But Detrian is not here.

I wonder what happens to people when they die. I wonder what happened to my brother.Open the journal."Looks like Hennika was crying when she wrote this."
[ES] Detrian se ha ido. Me hizo una muñeca de madera, y todavía la guardo en mi cama.
Me siento extraña. Las cosas de Detrian están aquí, pero él se ha ido.
Su ropa sigue aquí. Su espada está aquí. Pero Detrian no está aquí.

Me pregunto qué le pasa a la gente cuando muere. Me pregunto qué le pasó a mi hermano.Open the journal."Looks like Hennika was crying when she wrote this."

[EN] I want to be grown up like my brother and save people. I practice swordfighting everyday.
Every time I practice, I think of Detrian. It makes me sad.
Detrian once told me that, after I grow up, I can use a real sword, not a practice sword made of wood.

I miss my brother."Hm...there's more."
[ES] Quiero ser grande como mi hermano y salvar a la gente. Practico esgrima todos los días.
Cada vez que practico, pienso en Detrian. Me pone triste.
Detrian me dijo una vez que, cuando crezca, podré usar una espada de verdad, no una espada de práctica hecha de madera.

Extraño a mi hermano."Hm...there's more."

[EN] I made a friend today.

I was heading to the hill where Detrian and I used to go. Suddenly, a huge beast jumped out of the bushes.
I turned and ran as fast as I could. I accidently dropped Detrian’s sword, but I had no time to pick it up.
The beast came after me, and cornered me in a dead end.
But the beast didn’t kill me. He had something in his mouth, and dropped it right in front of me.

It was Detrian’s sword!
I picked it up, but the monster just stared at me.
Then strangely, I wasn't afraid anymore."Hennika made friends with a monster?"
[ES] Hice un amigo hoy.

Me dirigía a la colina a la que Detrian y yo solíamos ir. De repente, una bestia enorme saltó de los arbustos.
Me giré y corrí tan rápido como pude. Sin querer dejé caer la espada de Detrian, pero no tuve tiempo de recogerla.
La bestia fue tras de mí y me acorraló en un callejón sin salida.
Pero la bestia no me mató. Tenía algo en la boca y lo dejó caer justo en frente de mí.

¡Era la espada de Detrian!
La recogí, pero el monstruo simplemente se quedó mirándome.
Entonces, extrañamente, ya no tuve miedo."Hennika made friends with a monster?"

[EN] I was a good girl today.

I found a baby bird in the woods.
I picked it up, and Argog put me on his shoulder so we could put it back in its nest.
The tree was tall, but it didn’t stop us from returning the baby to his mother."She must have been so lonely."
[ES] Fui una buena niña hoy.

Encontré un pájaro bebé en el bosque.
Lo recogí y Argog me puso sobre su hombro para que pudiera devolverlo a su nido.
El árbol era alto, pero eso no nos impidió devolver el bebé a su madre."She must have been so lonely."
